en.text: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧子听父亲的教训； 亵慢人不听责备。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧子聽父親的教訓； 褻慢人不聽責備。

en.text: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

zhSimplified.text: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福； 奸诈人必遭强暴。

zhTraditional.text: 人因口所結的果子，必享美福； 奸詐人必遭強暴。

en.text: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

zhSimplified.text: 谨守口的，得保生命； 大张嘴的，必致败亡。

zhTraditional.text: 謹守口的，得保生命； 大張嘴的，必致敗亡。

en.text: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得； 殷勤人必得丰裕。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人羨慕，卻無所得； 殷勤人必得豐裕。

en.text: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

zhSimplified.text: 义人恨恶谎言； 恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。

zhTraditional.text: 義人恨惡謊言； 惡人有臭名，且致慚愧。

en.text: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

zhSimplified.text: 行为正直的，有公义保守； 犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。

zhTraditional.text: 行為正直的，有公義保守； 犯罪的，被邪惡傾覆。

en.text: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

zhSimplified.text: 假作富足的，却一无所有； 装作穷乏的，却广有财物。

zhTraditional.text: 假作富足的，卻一無所有； 裝作窮乏的，卻廣有財物。

en.text: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

zhSimplified.text: 人的资财是他生命的赎价； 穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。

zhTraditional.text: 人的資財是他生命的贖價； 窮乏人卻聽不見威嚇的話。

en.text: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

zhSimplified.text: 义人的光明亮； 恶人的灯要熄灭。

zhTraditional.text: 義人的光明亮； 惡人的燈要熄滅。

en.text: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲只启争竞； 听劝言的，却有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲只啟爭競； 聽勸言的，卻有智慧。

en.text: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

zhSimplified.text: 不劳而得之财必然消耗； 勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。

zhTraditional.text: 不勞而得之財必然消耗； 勤勞積蓄的，必見加增。

en.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

zhSimplified.text: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧； 所愿意的临到，却是生命树。

zhTraditional.text: 所盼望的遲延未得，令人心憂； 所願意的臨到，卻是生命樹。

en.text: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

zhSimplified.text: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡； 敬畏诫命的，必得善报。

zhTraditional.text: 藐視訓言的，自取滅亡； 敬畏誡命的，必得善報。

en.text: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人的法则是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人的法則是生命的泉源， 可以使人離開死亡的網羅。

en.text: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

zhSimplified.text: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩； 奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。

zhTraditional.text: 美好的聰明使人蒙恩； 奸詐人的道路崎嶇難行。

en.text: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

zhSimplified.text: 凡通达人都凭知识行事； 愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。

zhTraditional.text: 凡通達人都憑知識行事； 愚昧人張揚自己的愚昧。

en.text: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

zhSimplified.text: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里； 忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。

zhTraditional.text: 奸惡的使者必陷在禍患裏； 忠信的使臣乃醫人的良藥。

en.text: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

zhSimplified.text: 弃绝管教的，必致贫受辱； 领受责备的，必得尊荣。

zhTraditional.text: 棄絕管教的，必致貧受辱； 領受責備的，必得尊榮。

en.text: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

zhSimplified.text: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜； 远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。

zhTraditional.text: 所欲的成就，心覺甘甜； 遠離惡事，為愚昧人所憎惡。

en.text: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

zhSimplified.text: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。

zhTraditional.text: 與智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 和愚昧人作伴的，必受虧損。

en.text: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 祸患追赶罪人； 义人必得善报。

zhTraditional.text: 禍患追趕罪人； 義人必得善報。

en.text: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 善人给子孙遗留产业； 罪人为义人积存资财。

zhTraditional.text: 善人給子孫遺留產業； 罪人為義人積存資財。

en.text: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

zhSimplified.text: 穷人耕种多得粮食， 但因不义，有消灭的。

zhTraditional.text: 窮人耕種多得糧食， 但因不義，有消滅的。

en.text: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

zhSimplified.text: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他； 疼爱儿子的，随时管教。

zhTraditional.text: 不忍用杖打兒子的，是恨惡他； 疼愛兒子的，隨時管教。

en.text: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

zhSimplified.text: 义人吃得饱足； 恶人肚腹缺粮。

zhTraditional.text: 義人吃得飽足； 惡人肚腹缺糧。
